correctness.rationale: All maps preserve the simplex and positive supports by skew symmetry and strict |a_ij|<1. Bounded coordinate martingales have L2-summable conditional variances, forcing all limits into the stationary set {three vertices, r}. An explicit positive-kernel weighted-AMGM Lyapunov function is nonincreasing on every path and uniquely maximized at r, excluding r from limits unless started there. Optional-stopping is unnecessary: bounded expectation gives exact fixation probabilities. Cesàro replacement and IID sign strong law prove simultaneous losing exponents; dominated convergence of stationary initial laws proves the complete invariant-law simplex. Exact-rational finite-word checker independently matches each finite identity; finite checks are not substitutes for proofs.

The transitive fair sign-switching competition classification does not cover cyclic rock-paper-scissors matrices, which have a positive null vector and a shared interior fixed point. value.rationale: A 3-species rock-paper-scissors cycle is the smallest natural nontransitive competitive interaction. The full fixed-state and invariant-measure classification resolves a sharp exception to random fixation: exactly one positive coexistence composition is preserved forever, whereas arbitrarily close populations fixate with initial-share winner probabilities. Exact pathwise extinction exponents describe selective timescales, not merely convergence. The result is not a cosmetic parameter substitution of the transitive case because the cyclic equilibrium must be eliminated via a new strict positive-kernel Lyapunov argument.
